title: finding(plugin-form): the six record forms never clear `error` — a failed schema or record read keeps the form's error screen up after a later read succeeds (objectui#10663 family, outside its data-view census)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites and a reproduction. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 5 (`session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`) from the objectui#10663 dev report (PR objectui#10680, the family closure card for never-cleared `error`). That PR's census excluded the record forms as outside the data-view population, and named this as class a. The seat re-read the sites on objectui `origin/main` `7baede3`. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## Sites

Each form keeps an `error` state that its reads set and nothing clears. `setError(` writes / `setError(null)` writes on `origin/main`:

| form | `setError(` | `setError(null)` |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` (`:697`, `:791`, `:807`) | 3 | 0 |
| `DrawerForm.tsx` | 2 | 0 |
| `ModalForm.tsx` | 2 | 0 |
| `SplitForm.tsx` | 2 | 0 |
| `TabbedForm.tsx` | 2 | 0 |
| `WizardForm.tsx` | 2 | 0 |

**Reproduction** (the dev's throwaway probe, deleted, never committed): the real `SchemaRenderer` and the plugin-form registration, with `object-form` in edit mode. `findOne` fails once, then a `notifyDataChanged` re-read of the record succeeds ⇒ `errorBefore=true`, `findOneCalls=2`, `errorAfterSuccessfulReread=true`, `valueShown=false`. The other five were read at source only.

Since objectui#10572 the forms re-read on the data-invalidation bus, so a transient failure followed by any save elsewhere is an ordinary way in.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

The objectui#10578 shape (clear on a successful commit), with one caveat the dev raised: each form has TWO reads (the object schema and the record) and no run guard. So the rule is per source: a record read that succeeds over a failed schema read must not clear the schema failure. PR objectui#10680 (in review) is the precedent for the data views.

## Dedupe

Searched this repo with the MCP semantic issue search, including closed issues: `ObjectForm record form error screen never cleared after successful re-read findOne` ⇒ objectui#10190, objectui#10156, objectui#7354, objectui#7345, objectui#4292 and objectui#2968, all closed, all other plugin-form defects. None is about the form's `error` lifecycle, and the hits show the instrument is lit. objectui#10663 covers the data views, not the forms.

Dedupe words: `ObjectForm never clears error` · `record form error screen stays after re-read` · `DrawerForm ModalForm error never cleared` · `form setError null`
